# Inside Higher Ed

> > Inside Higher Ed is the leading news and career platform for higher education professionals, covering faculty issues, policy, and employment opportunities.

Inside Higher Ed serves as a comprehensive resource for faculty, administrators, and higher education professionals with breaking news, in-depth policy analysis, and a robust job board featuring 22,000+ positions. The platform covers critical issues including tenure reform, academic freedom, DEI initiatives, AI in education, and faculty career development.

## Key Topics

- Faculty Issues
- Tenure Reform
- Academic Employment
- Higher Education Policy
- Career Development
- Academic Freedom
- AI in Education
- Diversity & Equity
- Contingent Faculty
- Teaching & Pedagogy
- Student Assessment
- Campus Politics
- College Admissions
- Faculty Rights
- Curriculum Policy

## Jobs & Careers

- [Inside Higher Ed Careers](https://careers.insidehighered.com): Job board with 22,132+ live openings for higher education faculty and administrative roles
- [Employer Services](https://recruiters.insidehighered.com): Employer services platform for recruiting higher education professionals
- [Career Development](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues/career-development): Faculty career advice on hiring, tenure, promotion, salaries, and job search

## Faculty & Academic Employment

- [Faculty Issues](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues): Faculty issues news section covering tenure, governance, and academic careers
- [Tenure](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues/tenure): Coverage of tenure policy, faculty rights, reform, and academic employment issues
- [Contingent Faculty](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues/contingent-faculty): Coverage of adjunct and contingent faculty labor, compensation, and rights
- [Diversity & Equity](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues/diversity-equity): News on DEI policy, H1B visas, and diversity initiatives in higher education

## Teaching, Learning & Curriculum

- [Teaching](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues/teaching): Articles on teaching methods, pedagogy, AI in education, and faculty career advice
- [Learning & Assessment](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues/learning-assessment): Coverage of academic assessment, grade inflation, AI, and student integrity issues
- [Curriculum](https://www.insidehighered.com/news/faculty-issues/curriculum): News on curriculum policy, academic freedom, and state regulation of higher education

## Higher Education News & Analysis

- [News](https://www.insidehighered.com/news): Higher education news hub covering policy, admissions, rankings, and faculty issues
- [Homepage](https://www.insidehighered.com): Homepage for Inside Higher Ed with news, career advice, and events for higher education professionals
